thread:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: decode-pool-3 reported GPU OOMs (cudaErrorMalloc) and 503s. sample node: gpu-decode-12. Auto-quarantine triggered.

alice: seeing repeated OOM traces and a decode loop. A few customers reporting 5-8% request drops to /v1/generate. Logs show extremely long generation lengths.

ben: taking this. oncall (ben) here — I'm going to triage prefix vs max_tokens. If we can clamp at the proxy that's fastest.

carla: node is flapping (OOM -> container restart -> warmup -> OOM). Suggest cordon gpu-decode-12 and scale replica count by +2 in the pool.

dave: quick check of logs:
```
E CUDA: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
E runtime.decode: kv_cache growth=1.2GB/sec, tokens_in_req=220k
```
Customer SDKs might be sending `max_tokens` as 220000 due to a client bug.

ben: action list:
1) apply proxy clamp `X-Max-Tokens: 2048` for streaming route
2) route traffic to fallback-quant model for new requests
3) cordon + restart node
4) contact affected customers
I'll do 1 & 2 now.

dave: patch ready for proxy. small nginx lua hook to cap header:
```
if tonumber(ngx.req.get_headers()['X-Max-Tokens']) > 4096 then
  ngx.req.set_header('X-Max-Tokens','4096')
end
```
Deploying to edge-proxy pool-1.

alice: rolling out proxy change to 3 edge instances.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: started deploy to edge-proxy (deploy/edge-proxy/2026-03-17-14:22)

carla: cordoned gpu-decode-12 and draining. Running `kubectl drain gpu-decode-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` now.

dave: also opened temporary routing rule to fallback-32q model for the streaming route: weight 70% fallback, 30% primary.

eve: support note: impacted customers identified (acct: big-retailer, acct: beta-chat). Drafting comms: "We observed increased request drops and have applied mitigations; we'll follow up with RCA." ETA 30m for customer updates.

frank-csm: ping on ETA for node back up and full mitigation before I call customer? they want immediate update.

ben: node drain + restart in progress. ETA 12-15m to stabilize. proxy clamp applied, traffic routing in effect. Initial error rate dropped from 7% -> 1.3% in the last 4m.

alice: verifying no more OOMs on other nodes. Observability: KV cache growth stopped on streaming path after clamp.

dave: created a quick server-side validation to reject requests with `max_tokens > 10000` with 400 and a helpful error until proper SDK fix. Will merge to main and cut hotfix.

carla: gpu-decode-12 restarted and rejoined pool. Monitoring for 10m.

incident-bot: oncall-handoff scheduled: ben -> dave at 15:00 UTC for postmortem. Pager silence: true.

eve: sending customer note now. frank-csm: FYI sent to big-retailer, included temporary mitigations + ETA for RCA.

ben: next steps: postmortem to document
- root cause: client-side max_tokens misparse -> runaway generation
- mitigations: proxy clamp, server-side validation, fallback routing
- action items: SDK patch, create telemetry alert for token-rate-per-request
- owner: dave (SDK/server validation), carla (node drainage playbook update), alice (dashboard alert)

alice: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring and will file incident ticket with metrics + logs.

frank-csm: thanks team, customer on call appreciated the quick update :thumbsup:
